variants.espressif:

PASS CYD: stale generations cannot decode/play/publish; output failure is preserved; PCM frame alignment
PASS CYD PDM: flush final tail once with zero padding; discard/reset without replay; ASan/UBSan
PASS CYD: cancellation during queue waits; Play while output wakes; 2000 concurrent Play/Stop commands and stale callbacks
PASS CYD: AAC drain closes decoder after cached PCM; MP3 continues in the same generation; only final EOF flushes output
